fusions.name: Loaded With Grit
fusions.desc: Blasts a cone of gathered grit 3.5 tiles ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything in it.

fusions.name: Ramrod Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a packed slug that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Sighted Down the Haft
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to sight along the haft, then increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Ricochet
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a stray pellet deals 6 damage to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles. Once every 5 seconds.
